metadata.title: Nvidia has lost nearly $2 trillion in market cap since its October peak - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 min ago
Nvidia has lost nearly $2 trillion in market cap since its October peak
Shares of Nvidia traded 6.5% lower on Thursday morning, putting the stock on track for a new 52-week low.
Nvidia has lost $346.6 billion in market capitalization today. The company has lost $1.93 trillion in market capitalization since its peak on on Oct. 6 of this year, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
